blocks.text: ONE DAY, THE HEAD OF THE FBI HIMSELF|WANTED A CLOSER LOOK AT THIS PLAYBOY.
YOU'RE A DOUBLE AGENT|AND YOU LIVE LIKE|A MILLIONAIRE.
I'M BRINGING YOU|THE QUESTIONS BERLIN|IS ASKING ABOUT|PEARL HARBOR!
I DON'T NEED A PLAYBOY|TO DO MY JOB.|ONE FALSE STEP,|AND I'LL HAVE YOU ARRESTED.
ONLY POPOV TELLS|THIS SCENE. AND HE|WAITED FOR HOOVER|TO DIE BEFORE WRITING IT.
IN HIS PLACE, I'D HAVE|DONE THE SAME. HOOVER|HAD FILES ON EVERYONE.
